strings.name: Mitchell Baker
strings.summary: Mitchell Baker helped build Mozilla’s organizational and legal foundations and served as its corporate CEO. She advocates for the open web and public-interest technology. She left both Mozilla boards in 2025 and continued AI governance advisory work and published a European open source AI report in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Foundation and corporation, CEO and board roles are distinguished; birth date unconfirmed.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped organize Mozilla’s open web project, advancing browser competition, public-interest technology and user privacy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Berkeley Asian Studies bachelor’s degree in 1979 and professional law degree, JD, in 1987.
strings.facts.f2.label: Law and public principles
strings.facts.f2.value: Helped develop the Mozilla Public License and authored the Mozilla Manifesto.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building open web institutions
strings.highlights.h1.text: Worked with developers and volunteers on Mozilla and Firefox, combining a public mission with product development.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Open source AI governance proposals
strings.highlights.h2.text: Advocates considering licenses, teams, collaboration and organizational capacity together in open source AI policy.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Publishes European open source AI report
strings.timeline.t1.text: The AI and Society Institute publishes her report on governance and sustainability beyond licensing.
strings.timeline.t2.title: University announces advisory board appointment
strings.timeline.t2.text: Sheffield’s Centre for Machine Intelligence names her to its new External Stakeholder Advisory Board.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaves Mozilla boards
strings.timeline.t3.text: Mozilla announces the end of her chair and board roles at both foundation and corporation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Moves from CEO to executive chair
strings.timeline.t4.text: Mozilla Corporation announces Laura Chambers as CEO; Baker continues as executive chair.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Announces restructuring and layoffs
strings.timeline.t5.text: Announces roughly 250 job cuts, linking the changes to pandemic-related revenue effects.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Appointed permanent Mozilla Corporation CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: The board confirms the appointment; she had been interim CEO since December 2019.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Firefox 1.0 released
strings.timeline.t7.text: Mozilla Foundation releases the browser developed by employees and volunteers; Baker is foundation president.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Mozilla Foundation established
strings.timeline.t8.text: The founding announcement names Baker as president and Mitch Kapor as board chair.
